boards.name: karriere.at
boards.notes: Imprint lists offices in Linz and Wien, Austria; the imprint does not say which is the head office. Employer ad products start at EUR 949 per ad (Standard, 30 days). No language switcher, developer, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

boards.name: Jobbnorge
boards.notes: Language menu lists Norsk Bokmål, English, Norsk Nynorsk and Sámegiella (mapped to se, Northern Sami). Footer names Grade Jobbnorge AS with a Norwegian org. number. No prices, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

sources.title: Language menu
sources.quote: Norsk Bokmål English Norsk Nynorsk Sámegiella

boards.name: JobScout24
boards.notes: Employer page offers free job posting with optional paid visibility options. Footer carries the copyright line of JobCloud, which the page does not describe as a parent. No API, partner or headquarters statement was found in the pages read.

sources.title: Employer page
sources.quote: Publish it for free and boost its visibility with paid options whenever you need them.

boards.name: Valtiolle.fi
boards.notes: Finnish state job search service. Home page links a Swedish and an English version. The privacy notice gives a Helsinki visiting address for the controller. No pricing, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

boards.name: Tes Jobs
boards.notes: Jobs page footer states Tes Global Ltd is registered in England with its registered office in Sheffield; this is the registered office, not a stated head office. Advertise page describes a subscription for unlimited job adverts. No API or partner page was found in the pages read.

sources.title: Footer company registration
sources.quote: with its registered office at Building 3, St Paul's Place, Norfolk Street, Sheffield, S1 2JE

sources.title: Advertise a job
sources.quote: Subscribe and unlock unlimited job adverts, premium features to speed up your recruitment search

boards.name: KarieR.co
boards.notes: About page says listings are indexed from employer career sites and verified ATS systems, and that employers cannot buy higher ranking. No pricing, owner, headquarters or API page was found in the pages read.

boards.name: Seasonal Jobs in New Zealand
boards.notes: Footer names Create a Moment Ltd as the operator ("by Create a Moment Ltd."). The employer post-a-job page requires sign-in and shows no prices. The about page calls the site a free service for job seekers. No API, partner or headquarters statement was found in the pages read.

boards.name: HireDoc
boards.notes: Privacy page names ZnanyLekarz sp. z o.o. with its seat in Warsaw as operator and controller. Add-listing page offers a 90-day free listing. No language list, parent, API or partner page was found in the pages read.

sources.title: Polityka prywatności
sources.quote: z siedzibą pod adresem ul. Kolejowa 5/7/, 01-217 Warszawa

sources.title: Dodaj ogłoszenie
sources.quote: Dodaj ogłoszenie na 90 dni za darmo
